# Supported hardware

The audio cards and screens the setup wizard offers. The id is what `hardware.json` stores; picking a card writes its device-tree overlay to `/boot/firmware/config.txt`. For wiring, see [Wiring](../hardware/wiring.md).

## Audio cards

| Id | Card | Category | Overlay | ALSA card |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `hifiberry_amp2` | HiFiBerry Amp2 | amplifier | `hifiberry-dacplus-std` | `sndrpihifiberry` |
| `hifiberry_amp4` | HiFiBerry Amp4 | amplifier | `hifiberry-dacplus-std` | `sndrpihifiberry` |
| `hifiberry_amp4pro` | HiFiBerry Amp4 Pro | amplifier | `hifiberry-amp4pro` | `sndrpihifiberry` |
| `hifiberry_amp100` | HiFiBerry Amp100 | amplifier | `hifiberry-amp100` | `sndrpihifiberry` |
| `hifiberry_beocreate` | HiFiBerry Beocreate 4CA | amplifier | `hifiberry-dac` | `sndrpihifiberry` |
| `hifiberry_dac2hd` | HiFiBerry DAC2 HD | dac | `hifiberry-dacplushd` | `sndrpihifiberry` |
| `hifiberry_dacplus_pro` | HiFiBerry DAC2 Pro / DAC+ Pro | dac | `hifiberry-dacplus-pro` | `sndrpihifiberry` |
| `hifiberry_dac2adcpro` | HiFiBerry DAC2 ADC Pro | dac | `hifiberry-dacplusadcpro` | `sndrpihifiberry` |

`dac` cards need an external amplifier; `amplifier` cards drive speakers directly.

## Screens

| Id | Screen | Resolution | Color correction |
|---|---|---|---|
| `waveshare_7_usb` | Waveshare 7" 1024x600 (USB) | 1024x600 | — |
| `waveshare_8_dsi` | Waveshare 8" 1280x800 (DSI) | 1280x800 | R, G, B × 1, 0.875, 0.768 |

A color correction is a fixed gain per channel that brings the panel's white to D65; only a panel calibrated with a colorimeter carries one.

## Default GPIO pins

BCM numbering.

| Input | Pin |
|---|---|
| Rotary encoder CLK | 22 |
| Rotary encoder DT | 27 |
| Rotary encoder switch | 23 |
| IR receiver | 17 |
| Power button LED (cathode) | 26 |
